script.title: What actually happens when a black hole shreds your body
script.description: A step-by-step scientific thriller detailing the physical destruction and time-warping effects of falling into a black hole.

shots.narration: A black hole stretches your body into atoms.
You have fifteen seconds of consciousness.
Gravity here is millions of times stronger.
Small black holes shred you instantly.
Light warps into glowing concentric rings.
Time dilation freezes your image forever.
Your signals shift to red wavelengths.
To observers you never cross over.
But your reality is far worse.
Tidal forces pull at your feet.
Gravity scales with terrifying speed now.
You still see the entire galaxy.
Outside light still reaches your eyes.
Cosmic events unfold in fast forward.
But you can never turn back.
Every photon moves strictly inward now.
Your bones yield to tidal oscillations.
Matter heats into intense X-ray flares.
You are squeezed like cosmic dough.
Your timeline points to the singularity.
You become a stream of atoms.
